title: Entitlement-proving workflow and SIEM export spec
content:
Purpose:
This is a working draft for how we will prove entitlements for quarterly least-privilege recertification and privileged access audits, with concrete output formats for SIEM export and automation hooks for evidence collection. The focus is RBAC v2 role grants, temporary elevated sessions, service-account keys, and control-plane access patterns across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.

Scope (what this doc covers):
- Definition of acceptable evidence artifacts per entitlement type (user role, service account, delegated role, SSH/key material, cloud IAM link).
- Sampling and rotation guidance for quarterly recertification: sampling matrix, confidence targets, and exception handling.
- Audit log schema mapping for SIEM export (field list + example events).
- Lightweight automation flow (what’s automated vs manual) and required integrations (Okta/Azure AD, internal RBAC API, KMS).
- Owner/responsibility model and runbook for auditors + remediation triage.

High-level goals and constraints:
- Minimize manual spreadsheet work; push evidence artifacts into a canonical object store for 2y retention (evidence blobs + indexes).
- SIEM export must contain deterministic IDs to correlate an entitlement assertion to the logs used as evidence.
- We need to support both continuous evidence collection for high-risk entitlements and sampled proofs for low-risk entitlements, to keep cost reasonable.
- Preserve PII minimization in exported logs — no full email addresses unless needed. Use hashed principal ids when possible.

Definitions and entitlement categories (quick):
- Role Assignment: user -> role (RBAC v2 role id). Evidence = role grant record (API call, identity provider assertion, timestamp).
- Delegated/Inherited Role: role granted via group (e.g., group membership). Evidence = group membership snapshot + group->role mapping.
- Temporary Elevation Session: just-in-time (JIT) elevation (MFA token recorded). Evidence = session start/stop logs, requester id, approver id, TTL.
- Service Principal / Key Material: long-lived keys or short-lived tokens. Evidence = last-used timestamp, key fingerprint, key owner, rotation policy state.
- Cloud Provider IAM Link: when Redwood maps to cloud IAM roles. Evidence = cloud policy attach/detach events, resource ARNs.

Evidence matrix (summary lines; sampling guidance below):
- High risk roles (prod DB admin, infra-admin, billing-admin): continuous proof + per-change alerts + 100% on recertification (owner must verify each entitlement).
- Medium risk (service management, deployer): sampled 50% per quarter with automatic verification where API audit exists.
- Low risk (read-only dashboards, product-analytics): 10% sample + automated evidence via periodic sync.

Sampling methodology (work-in-progress):
- Quarterly cadence broken into 3 waves over a 6-week window. Owners assigned by role namespace owner.
- Use stratified sampling across teams, role criticality, and last-modified interval to choose samples.
- Confidence target: 95% for high- and medium-risk strata over rolling 4 quarters.
- If a sampled entitlement has stale or missing evidence, escalate to remediation: 1) request owner proof (48h), 2) read-only suspension (if stale >30d), 3) remove entitlement (if >90d unresolved).

Audit log schema for SIEM export (fields we will emit):
- event_id: string (uuid-v4)
- recorded_at: string (ISO8601)
- event_type: string (role_grant | role_revoke | group_change | session_start | session_end | key_rotation | key_use)
- principal_hash: string (sha256 of principal id; reversible mapping kept in vault for auditors)
- principal_type: string (user | service_account | group)
- principal_display: string (redwood:alphanum; obfuscated email ok)
- role_id: string (rbacv2-<shortid>)
- role_name: string
- grant_via: string (direct | group | policy)
- resource_scope: string (global | org:123 | project:abc)
- changed_by: string (principal_hash or system)
- change_request_id: string (optional, links to JIRA/approval record)
- evidence_blob_id: string (pointer to evidence store)
- evidence_tags: string (comma list: e.g., iam-api, okta, cloud-audit)
- metadata: string (small freeform; key=value pairs)

Example SIEM event (flattened single-line JSON we will ship):
{
  "event_id": "c4b8f2d2-9c2e-4f6e-b3b2-2a1d7a5b6e2f",
  "recorded_at": "2025-09-28T14:02:11Z",
  "event_type": "role_grant",
  "principal_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "principal_type": "user",
  "principal_display": "a.patel (okta)",
  "role_id": "rbacv2-er1",
  "role_name": "infra-admin",
  "grant_via": "direct",
  "resource_scope": "org:root",
  "changed_by": "system:provisioning-service",
  "change_request_id": "JIRA-SEC-4127",
  "evidence_blob_id": "evidence/2025/09/role-grant/c4b8f2d2",
  "evidence_tags": "okta,iam-api",
  "metadata": "ttl=162d;region=us-west-2"
}

Evidence store contract (minimal):
- Evidence blobs stored in S3-like bucket with path pattern: evidence/YYYY/MM/<type>/<event_id>
- Each blob is an archived, signed tar.gz containing: 1) raw API response(s) used to assert the entitlement, 2) redaction.txt explaining PII removal, 3) minimal index.json (sha256 checksums + record pointers).
- Blob metadata (indexed in our internal index DB) must include: event_id, principal_hash, role_id, recorded_at, owner, retention_expiry.
- Retention default = 2 years; high-risk = 7 years.

Automation plan (technical sketch):
- Source connectors: Okta SCIM webhooks, internal RBAC API change events, cloud provider audit export (CloudTrail -> collector), KMS key rotation webhook.
- Collector service responsibilities: normalize events to SIEM schema, generate evidence blobs (snapshot API calls + enrollment data), sign and store the blob, emit one SIEM event per normalized event.
- Backfill: for recert cycles we need a backfill tool to snapshot current state and produce synthetic "proof events" dated at snapshot time with evidence blobs. This is required where historical change events are incomplete.
- Orchestration: Use a lightweight job that seeds recertification campaigns from the index DB and invites owners via email + slack with links to the evidence portal. Track responses via change_request_id.

Queries (examples for auditors):
- Splunk/Elastic: find all grants for role=rbacv2-er1 in the last 90d -> filter event_type=role_grant AND role_id=rbacv2-er1 | dedup principal_hash | table recorded_at, principal_display, evidence_blob_id
- Find stale keys: event_type=key_use | stats latest(recorded_at) by principal_hash, key_fingerprint | where latest < now()-30d

Owner and responsibility model (proposed):
- Role owner: product or platform area responsible for role definition and owner verification tasks (must respond to recert within 48h on sampled items).
- Evidence steward (security): responsible for evidence index, retention policy, and audit support requests.
- Audit lead: runs the quarterly campaign, triages escalations, issues second-level remediation tickets.

Runbook snippets (for auditors):
- When a sampled entitlement lacks evidence_blob: mark as "missing-evidence" and assign to owner with a 48h SLA.
- If owner confirms entitlement via out-of-band proof (email + CLI output), create evidence blob using backfill tool and attach blob id to ticket.
- If entitlement is unnecessary, owner must file a JIRA ticket to revoke; link that ticket id to change_request_id.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How do we handle cross-tenant RBAC mapping for private deployments without shipping customer PII to central SIEM? (Possible answer: hash tenant id + encrypt mapping in HSM.)
- Agree on canonical principal identifier across Okta, internal LDAP, and cloud provider. Need a small mapping table and sync job.
- Decide: evidence blobs signed by security key vs ingesting service key. Risk profile differs.
- Which low-risk roles can be fully auto-certified (owner auto-approves unless callout)? Draft list needed.

Immediate next steps (short checklist):
- [ ] Engineering: prototype normalized SIEM event emitter (schema above) using one Okta webhook -> due 2025-10-17 (owner: Marcus Liu)
- [ ] Security: define retention matrix (2y/7y) and implement index DB fields (owner: Elena Rodriguez)
- [ ] Product: produce list of high/medium/low roles and owners (owner: Priya Nair)
- [ ] Compliance: validate the evidence blob contract with legal for e-discovery (owner: Samir Desai)

Notes to self / conversational fragments:
- Want to avoid another huge spreadsheet this quarter — the goal is to have owners click a single link that shows evidence and a single-click "confirm/revoke" button.
- If we can tie change_request_id to existing JIRA requests created by provisioning infra, that will massively reduce context switching.
- Need to finalize format for principal_display: human-friendly, but we must not leak full email for customer tenants.

References and related docs:
- CONFLUENCE-SEC/entitlement-model-v2 (role model and namespace rules)
- SIEM export proto (internal repo link in linked_artifacts)
- JIRA-SEC-4127 (project tracking automation effort)

If you are reading this and have immediate objections to the schema or evidence contract, please ping me in #sec-rbac. This is intentionally a working doc; expect changes as infra implements the prototype and we see edge cases.

-- Aisha
